svg.title: The mesh pilot and the gameplay adoption boundary
svg.desc: Editable Blender source, converted geometry, and a native GPU pilot describe a pipeline. Gameplay adoption remains a separate gate involving ground contact, occlusion, picking, atmosphere, and representative frame-time measurement. The diagram does not assert that the collectible shrine is a default pilot asset.
svg.text: A mesh can cross the pipeline before it joins the island.

g.text: Gameplay adoption remains a separate gate.
Ground contact · Occlusion · Picking · Atmosphere · Representative frame time

svg.text: Schematic pipeline; dashed boundary is proposed work, not a completed delivery path.
